subtitle: Design Project III(Kindo Toshiki)

KINDO Toshiki
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal: In this capstone project, students will conduct research activities related to IT systems based on the knowledge and skills related to computer science and technology that they have learned so far. Through these activities, students acquire the abilities needed for identifying a problem, designing the project, and implementing an IT system. Additionally, students will acquire generic abilities related to communicating with others, and evaluating results.
advice:
In accordance with the lab policy of "Research that affects society", you will study in implementation / development of "slightly intelligent agents" that respond to social needs using artificial intelligence or information technology in a broad sense.
On recommended steps, first identify your social needs, and then clarify existing technologies and new necessary functions to solve them. In doing so, make sure that the technology or function you handle belongs to the artificial intelligence and information technology fields in a broad sense. In the field of artificial intelligence, comprehensive materials will be provided, so be sure to acquire broad and well-balanced knowledge as well as technologies used to solve problems.
Your studies will be either system research that combines existing technologies and new functions, or elemental technology research that realizes new functions, or both. When you would like to tackle systems research, you will do collaborative works with other students.

Possible themes for 2026:
Natural language processing: Applied research into educational support technologies, applied research into collaborative filtering, and research into technologies that support group communication.
Computer vision: Research into applied technologies that combine image processing and information theory, and research into the fusion of images and 3D data.
books: You have to read books you need to reach your goal.

In the field of artificial intelligence, comprehensive materials will be provided, so be sure to acquire broad and well-balanced knowledge as well as technologies used to solve problems.
Your studies will be either system research that combines existing technologies and new functions, or elemental technology research that realizes new functions, or both. When you would like to tackle systems research, you will do collaborative works with other students.

Possible themes for 2026:
Natural language processing: Applied research into educational support technologies, applied research into collaborative filtering, and research into technologies that support group communication.
Computer vision: Research into applied technologies that combine image processing and information theory, and research into the fusion of images and 3D data.
